text: TSA estimates that 85.43 percent of visitors are US Citizens/LPRs, resulting in an estimated annual average of 11,603 domestic checks. TSA estimates that a visitor check of a US Citizen/LPR will take 3 minutes, or 0.05 hours, per check. Domestic checks are performed by either a G or H band employee.  Based on TSA wage data, TSA uses an average hourly fully loaded compensation rate of $40.44 for these employees. TSA multiplies the number of domestic checks, time per check, and hourly loaded rate to estimate an annual estimated cost of $23,462 (11,603 × 0.05 × $40.44) for domestic visitor checks.

text: Foreign visitors to TSA are checked by DHS. TSA collects information on each foreign visitor before forwarding the information to DHS. TSA also processes information received from DHS on each foreign visitor. TSA estimates that 14.57 percent of visitors are foreign, resulting in an estimated annual average of 1,979 foreign checks. TSA estimates that forwarding information to DHS will take 5 minutes, or 0.08333 hours. Furthermore, TSA estimates that processing information received from DHS will take 5.47718 minutes, or 0.09129 hours. These checks are performed by an I Band employee.  Based on TSA wage data, TSA uses an average hourly fully loaded compensation rate of $66.79 for these employees. TSA calculates an annualized cost for foreign visitor checks by summing the total estimated time per foreign check, then multiplying by the estimated number of annual checks and the fully loaded wage rate, for an estimated average annual cost of $23,080 ((0.08333 hours + 0.09129 hours = 0.17462 ) × 1,979 annual foreign visitors × $66.79).  TSA estimates an annual total cost to TSA by summing the costs of US/LPR checks ($23,462) and foreign visitor checks ($23,080.). TSA calculates a total annualized cost to the TSA of $46,542 ($23,462 + $23,080).
